zoe_cs: Sparkline onboarding ticket - customer sees 429s during rapid scale of serverless workers after they added a warm-up function.

zoe_cs: snippet they shared: 
```
# handler
token = requests.post('https://auth.sparkline.app/get').json()['token']
resp = requests.post('https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat', headers={'Authorization': f'Bearer {token}'}, json=payload)
```

sam_platform: ephemeral token per invocation + no session reuse. ask if auth returns ttl. this is likely a token-refresh stampede.

zoe_cs: auth returns {"token":"...","ttl":45}. customer using python lambda with new process per event.

mia_se: quick mitigation: 1) cache token in-process until ttl-5s, 2) use requests.Session() for keep-alive, 3) add small randomized sleep on cold start (0-1s). share tiny patch.

mia_se: patch (concept): 
```
_session = requests.Session()
_cache = {'t':None,'e':0}
def get_token():
  if time.time() < _cache['e']-5: return _cache['t']
  r = requests.post('https://auth.sparkline.app/get')
  data = r.json(); _cache.update({'t':data['token'],'e':time.time()+data['ttl']}); return _cache['t']
# use _session.post(..., headers={'Authorization': f'Bearer {get_token()}'})
```

zoe_cs: customer applied in staging -> 429s fell from 7% to 0.5% in 15m. they will canary in prod at 10%.

sam_platform: I'll open a 20m mitigation window to soften hard 429s for that tenant while they ramp; ops_bot please create ticket.

ops_bot: mitigation created #CS-5001 owner=sam_platform expires=20m playbook=token-cache-grace

zoe_cs: customer asked if we can add a gateway header to indicate auth-pressure so their SRE can alert. noted for product feedback and renewal confidence.

mia_se: we can prototype an opt-in header like x-token-pressure=high when >50 auth checks/min. filing follow-up.

zoe_cs: prod canary started. will monitor dashboards and report back in 30m. thanks all :thumbsup:
